Description:
Discover a captivating assortment of gemstones perfect for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or jewelry makers. This diverse lot features rough and polished stones in various shapes and colors, including visible rose quartz clusters, polished agate, vibrant purple amethyst, cabochon-style red glass pieces, tumbled quartz, and small fossil fragments. Some pieces are in crystal point and geode slice forms, while others are smooth or naturally textured, offering both natural and manmade variations. You'll also find a small bottle and bag of rose quartz chips, adding to the versatile mix. These stones can be used for crafting, display, or as unique decorative elements for the home or office. The variety offers creative flexibility, and the combination of rough and polished specimens brings visual interest to any collection. All items are in pre-owned condition, with minor signs of handling, making them an excellent option for creative projects and stone lovers alike
